resumeText:
PRIYA NANDAKUMAR
Email: priya.nandakumar@example.com | Phone: 0400 123 456
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/priyanandakumar

SUMMARY
Recent Master of IT graduate with hands-on experience building web applications using React, TypeScript and Node.js. Completed a capstone project delivering a full-stack booking platform and an internship contributing to a customer-facing dashboard. Looking to bring strong front-end fundamentals and a collaborative approach to a Junior Frontend Developer role.

SKILLS
JavaScript, TypeScript, React, HTML, CSS, Redux, Node.js, Express, REST APIs, Git, Jest, Figma, Tailwind CSS

EXPERIENCE
Frontend Developer Intern, BrightPath Digital
02/2024 - 07/2024
Supported the web team on a customer dashboard product built with React and Redux.
- Rebuilt the dashboard's filter component using React hooks, replacing an older class-based version.
- Wrote Jest unit tests for the new filter component to cover edge cases the team had previously handled manually.
- Worked with the design team to translate Figma mockups into responsive Tailwind CSS layouts.
- Improved the loading experience of the dashboard's main table by introducing skeleton loading states.

Junior IT Support Assistant (Part-time, while studying), Campus Tech Helpdesk
03/2022 - 12/2022
- Resolved student and staff laptop and Wi-Fi connectivity issues during scheduled shifts.
- Documented common troubleshooting steps in a shared knowledge base used by the helpdesk team.
- Assisted with onboarding new helpdesk volunteers by walking them through ticketing software.

PROJECTS
TableTime - Restaurant Booking Platform
GitHub: github.com/priyanandakumar/tabletime
- Built a full-stack booking application with React front-end and Express/Node.js back-end, including a calendar view and email confirmation flow.
- Implemented authentication with JWT and protected booking routes for logged-in users.
- Deployed the app using Netlify (frontend) and Render (backend) for the capstone demo.

ExpenseSplit - Group Expense Tracker
GitHub: github.com/priyanandakumar/expensesplit
- Created a React and Redux app that lets users split shared expenses and track balances between group members.
- Added CSV export of expense history using a lightweight Node.js API endpoint.

EDUCATION
Master of Information Technology
Greenfield University
02/2023 - 11/2024
- Capstone project: TableTime booking platform (see Projects).
- Relevant coursework: Web Application Development, Human-Computer Interaction, Software Engineering Practice.

Bachelor of Computer Applications
Sunrise College
06/2018 - 05/2021

CERTIFICATIONS
- freeCodeCamp: Responsive Web Design (2023)
- freeCodeCamp: JavaScript Algorithms and Data Structures (2023)
